notes:
First full release of the 2.1.0 line, closing out the two release candidates.

Requires Foundry v14 and the PF2e or SF2e system.

New

  • FENRIS Mech — Hahne-Kedar's quadruped security mech, in ME Creatures. It runs its target down, tasers it prone, and detonates if the wreck is disturbed. Carries a Light Combat Frame rather than shields, and weakness 3 to electricity.
  • Ancestry journal pages for every playable ancestry.
  • Paragon/Renegade is reachable from a character sheet header button, and recognises the older perk names.

Tokens

  • Token art for the bestiaries — 153 ring-ready tokens baked into the module, so no token module is needed at the table.
  • Crops centre on the head. The bake reads the silhouette to find the shoulder line and frames the head above centre, instead of assuming the face is at the top of the picture. Game stills with no transparency still use the old rule and can be corrected per file in assets/img/token-focus.json.
  • Optional Tokenizer 2 framing. With Tokenizer 2 installed, the module can composite a frame onto an actor's token the first time it is dropped, with the frame chosen in Tokenizer's own browser. Off by default; nothing changes without it.

Fixed

  • The manifest had been advertising a v2.1.0-rc.2 download that was never released, so update checks were failing. The URLs now point at this tag.
  • Statblock audit across the NPC packs.

Note for GMs on rc.1

The compendium packs are rebuilt on every release. Anything edited inside a module pack will be replaced — copy it into a world compendium first. Actors already imported into a world are untouched.
